description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is a Fragment subclass used in an Android application to display logs within a ScrollView. It initializes and configures a custom LogView component, handles view inflation, and updates scroll position on log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView to display log messages in an Android application.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding, then returns the root ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher on the LogView to auto-scroll when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in the fragment for external access.
